crossRefs.note: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man…
The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there…
Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

translations.web: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
translations.bsb: God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
translations.kjv: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
translations.asv: And God made the beasts of the earth after their kind, and the cattle after their kind, and everything that creepeth upon the ground after its kind: and God saw that it was good.
